sections.description: This section establishes the foundational medical context by analyzing the patient's multimorbid profile and explaining the sequence of events leading to interventional necessity. It covers the natural history of aortic stenosis, the limitations of the primary and secondary bioprostheses, and the pathophysiology of infective endocarditis complicating transcatheter valve anatomy.
subtopics: Patient demographic profile and assessment of surgical risk (EuroSCORE II)
Pathophysiology of bioprosthetic valve degeneration and structural valve deterioration (SVD)
Clinical presentation of recurrent aortic stenosis and heart failure symptoms
Pathophysiology of Infective Endocarditis (enterococcus) and impact on valve integrity
Integration of prior medical history (CAD, pacemaker, COPD) into risk stratification

sections.section_title: Diagnostic Reasoning and Interventional Strategy Formulation
sections.description: This section details the multidisciplinary decision-making process employed by the 'Heart Team' to navigate the complex overlap of heart failure, prior transplant history, and infection. It explains the criteria used to determine that a third TAVI was feasible despite the high stent burden, focusing on the resolution of infection and prohibitive surgical risk.
subtopics: Assessment of active versus resolved infective endocarditis prior to re-intervention
Decision algorithm for TAVI-in-TAVI-in-TAV versus surgical valve replacement
Guideline-directed medical therapy completion and infectious disease clearance criteria
Risk-benefit analysis of serial transcatheter reinterventions versus open aortic valve replacement
Strategic objectives for preserving coronary ostia and ensuring future access

sections.description: This section focuses on the critical role of multidetector computed tomography (MDCT) in selecting the appropriate valve size and deployment position. It outlines how 3D reconstruction and measurement of the 'landing zone' were utilized to calculate the risk of coronary obstruction and select the Acurate neo2 prosthesis.
subtopics: MDCT assessment of valve loading Geometry and stent-frame overlap
Measurement of landing zone dimensions and minimum lumen diameter
Coronary ostial height analysis and valve-to-coronary interaction simulation
Selection rationale for self-expanding prosthesis frame geometry
Planning for commissural alignment and maximum effective orifice area preservation

sections.section_title: Procedural Execution: Technical Nuances of Triple Valve Implantation
sections.description: This section describes the hands-on technical aspects of the third valve implantation, highlighting specific maneuvers to prevent thromboembolic events and ensure hemodynamic competence. It details the deployment techniques, post-dilation strategies, and real-time monitoring for coronary patency during the TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV procedure.
subtopics: Access strategy: Radial and femoral arterial cannulation
Balloon pre-dilation techniques under rapid ventricular pacing
Device implantation strategy: Supra-annular alignment and high deployment
Mitigation of prosthetic balancing to prevent neo-skirt formation
Intra-procedural aortography for checking coronary flow and valve position
Post-dilation management to optimize frame expansion and leaflet mobility

sections.section_title: 1-Year Clinical Outcomes and Broader Clinical Significance
sections.description: This section analyzes the long-term durability of the tri-implanted valve system and the patient's clinical recovery. It evaluates hemodynamic success using Valve Academic Research Consortium-3 criteria and discusses the implications for long-term management of patients undergoing multiple TAVI procedures.
subtopics: Follow-up assessment using Echocardiography (AVA, gradients, EF) at 1 year
Evaluation of prosthetic valve mismatch (PPM) and hemodynamic adequacy
Monitoring for recurrent endocarditis or structural valve deterioration
Challenges of future coronary reaccess in triple-stented anatomy
Implications for patient counseling and lifetime management of structural heart disease
